prompt_text:
Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 2 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 3 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 4 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 5 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 6 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import asyncio
import os
import pyaudio
from deepgram import (
    DeepgramClient,
    DeepgramClientOptions,
    LiveTranscriptionEvents,
    LiveOptions,
    Microphone,
)

# Audio configuration
RATE = 16000
CHUNK = 1024
FORMAT = pyaudio.paInt16
CHANNELS = 1

async def stream_microphone_audio():
    """
    Streams audio from the microphone to Deepgram and yields interim transcripts.
    """
    # Ensure DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is set in environment variables
    DEEPGRAM_API_KEY = os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
    if not DEEPGRAM_API_KEY:
        raise ValueError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY environment variable not set.")

    # Configure Deepgram Client
    # verbose=0 for production, set to 1 for more debugging output
    config: DeepgramClientOptions = DeepgramClientOptions(verbose=0)
    deepgram = DeepgramClient(DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, config)

    # Establish a streaming connection to Deepgram
    # LiveOptions are crucial for specifying streaming parameters and requesting interim results
    live_connection = await deepgram.listen.asynclive.v("1").transcribe.websocket_async(
        LiveOptions(
            smart_format=True,
            language="en-US",
            encoding="linear16",
            channels=CHANNELS,
            sample_rate=RATE,
            interim_results=True,  # Request interim transcripts
        )
    )

    # Use an asyncio Queue to pass transcripts from the event handler to the generator
    transcript_queue = asyncio.Queue()

    # Define the event handler for incoming transcripts
    def on_transcript(result, **kwargs):
        transcript = result.channel.alternatives[0].transcript
        # Only put non-empty transcripts into the queue
        if transcript:
            # Schedule the queue put operation on the event loop
            asyncio.create_task(transcript_queue.put(transcript))

    # Register event handlers
    live_connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_transcript)
    live_connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Close, lambda _: print("Deepgram connection closed."))
    live_connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Error, lambda e: print(f"Deepgram Error: {e}"))

    # Set up PyAudio for microphone input
    audio_instance = pyaudio.PyAudio()
    microphone_stream = audio_instance.open(
        format=FORMAT,
        channels=CHANNELS,
        rate=RATE,
        input=True,
        frames_per_buffer=CHUNK,
    )

    # Initialize Deepgram's Microphone utility to send audio chunks
    microphone = Microphone(live_connection)
    await microphone.start()

    print("Listening for speech... Press Ctrl+C to stop.")

    # Task to continuously read audio from the microphone and send it to Deepgram
    async def send_audio_to_deepgram():
        try:
            while True:
                audio_chunk = microphone_stream.read(CHUNK, exception_on_overflow=False)
                await live_connection.send(audio_chunk)
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)  # Small delay to prevent busy-waiting
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass  # Task was cancelled, exit gracefully

    audio_sender_task = asyncio.create_task(send_audio_to_deepgram())

    try:
        # Continuously yield transcripts received from Deepgram
        while True:
            transcript = await transcript_queue.get()
            yield transcript
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        print("Transcription yielding task cancelled.")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("Stopping microphone and transcription.")
    finally:
        print("Cleaning up resources...")
        # Cancel the audio sending task
        if audio_sender_task and not audio_sender_task.done():
            audio_sender_task.cancel()
            await audio_sender_task  # Wait for the task to finish cancelling

        # Finish the Deepgram microphone and connection
        await microphone.finish()
        await live_connection.finish()

        # Stop and close PyAudio stream
        microphone_stream.stop_stream()
        microphone_stream.close()
        audio_instance.terminate()
